qualification.details: Project Associate I: Four years bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/BVSc/B.Pharm or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized university or equivalent. Experience: Preferred: Bachelor's degree in physics / Electronics / Opto-Electronics (minimum of 7 CGPA is required). Experience in photonics, optical communication systems, or experimental optics within a research and development environment and hands-on experience with optical instrumentation including Mode-Locked Lasers (MLL), Optical Spectrum Analyser (OSA), oscilloscopes, Electronic Spectrum Analyser (ESA) and fiber-optic systems. Proficiency in MATLAB for simulation, signal processing, and data analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.

salary_details.details: Rs. 37,000/- + 30% HRA to those selected through CSIR-UGC NET, including Lectureship or GATE, or a selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions. Rs. 30,000/- + 30%HRA for those who do not fall under the above category.

selection_process: Screening and testing for short listing and selection
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Project Associate I Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Associate I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate I position at IIT Madras is 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/BVSc/B.Pharm or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized university or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate I position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA), depending on the selection criteria.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Madras for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate I post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Madras Project Associate I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate I position at IIT Madras is temporary.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Madras located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600036.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ICSR/PR/Advt.162/2026.
